content.user_title: Check What Works When You Travel
content.value_statement: An app, payment method, or mobile plan that works at home may not work abroad. Use destination guides to check compatibility, identify restrictions, and plan what to set up before departure.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve destination overviews and find guides for specific travel technology questions.
Distinguish between working, conditional, blocked, and workaround-required options when the guide provides a status.
Separate provider claims from reported real-world results and highlight setup steps and limits.
Compare listed eSIM and VPN providers and disclose possible affiliate commissions when sharing referral links or codes.
Read public country and guide resources without an API key when MCP is unavailable.
Send an outdated-information report through MCP when the user explicitly requests it.
limitations: Answers depend on available guides and may not reflect recent changes in rules, service coverage, or fees.
The skill does not test a specific phone, card, account, or connection.
The skill does not buy plans, install apps, or verify payment accounts.
Without MCP, the skill documents public lookups but does not provide a way to submit reports.

use_cases.title: Prepare Mobile Payments for China
use_cases.description: Check foreign card conditions for Alipay and WeChat Pay. Identify any verification steps to complete before departure.

use_cases.title: Compare Connectivity for Remote Work
use_cases.description: Compare listed eSIM and VPN options for a destination. Note any setup requirements, coverage limits, and usage caps described in the guides.

use_cases.title: Plan Transit and Navigation in Japan
use_cases.description: Check Apple Wallet transit card and map app guidance. Use the reported restrictions to prepare options for the group.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Transit Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether Apple Wallet Suica works for visitors to Japan. List the setup steps from the guide.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Ask about one product and destination.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Payment Apps
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Alipay and WeChat Pay for foreign cards in China. Separate setup steps, reported fees, and limits.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Connectivity Providers
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare listed eSIM providers for South Korea. Include stated data limits and setup requirements. Disclose any affiliate links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare provider conditions and referral disclosures.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Across Destinations
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my eSIM, payment, and map options for Japan and South Korea. Separate provider claims from reported results. Mark missing evidence and group setup steps by destination.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine multiple topics and destinations.

output_examples.input: What should I check before relying on Alipay with a foreign card in China?
output: Illustrative result: Check whether the guide lists your card type and whether it requires account verification.
Before departure: Complete the applicable verification steps while you still have access to your usual phone number.
Limits: Confirm current fees and transaction limits with the provider before relying on the card.

output_examples.input: Compare travel eSIM plans for Japan and focus on data limits.
output: Illustrative result: A plan is conditional if the provider reduces speeds after a daily usage limit.
Before departure: Confirm that your phone is unlocked and supports eSIM.
Comparison note: Treat plans without a stated cap as unverified, not unlimited.

best_practices: Name the destination and product and share only non-sensitive details needed for the lookup.
Ask for setup steps before departure and keep them separate from restrictions you may face after arrival.
Verify current fees and compatibility with the provider before making a purchase.
anti_patterns: Sharing card numbers, account credentials, or booking references in a lookup or report.
Treating a guide status as a guarantee for every phone, account, or merchant.
Using a referral as proof that a plan is suitable for your destination.

faq.question: Which assistants are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The listing names Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Lookups require access to the MCP server or public web resources.

faq.question: Can I use it without MCP?
faq.answer: Yes, the skill describes public country and guide resources that do not require an API key. The assistant still needs web access.

faq.question: Which destinations does it cover?
faq.answer: The skill names China, Japan, Hong Kong, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, Taiwan, and Europe as examples. Coverage varies by destination and topic.

faq.question: Does a positive result guarantee that my device or card will work?
faq.answer: No. Check the guide conditions and confirm current requirements with your device, card, or service provider.

faq.question: Can provider recommendations include affiliate links?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill directs the assistant to disclose when Does It Work In may earn a commission and explain what the traveler receives.

faq.question: Can I report outdated information?
faq.answer: Yes, when MCP is connected and you explicitly request a report. Describe the change without including personal or account details.
